reason: My whole day runs on Viber voice notes, with staff, suppliers, everyone. I'm not installing WhatsApp or Telegram just to talk to my website, and if it's not where I already am, I'll forget it exists within a week, like the old site.
objection: No Viber. Everything else sounds nice, but a tool I have to remember to open in another app is just the same dead website with a monthly bill.
would_change_my_mind: Viber support, so I can send it a voice note in the same app I use all day.
